description: You are a GIS Analyst at a regional development organization. You need to create a thematic map service that classifies world countries by continent. Log in to GeoServer at http://localhost:8080/geoserver/web/ (admin / Admin123!). Complete all of the following: (1) Create a workspace named 'regional_atlas' with namespace URI 'http://atlas.regional.example.org'. (2) Create a PostGIS datastore named 'world_geodata' inside this workspace connecting to gs-postgis:5432, database 'gis', user 'geoserver', password 'geoserver123'. (3) Publish the 'ne_countries' table from that datastore as a layer named 'countries' in the 'regional_atlas' workspace. (4) Create an SLD style named 'continent_colors' with exactly 7 classification rules — one per continent (Africa, Antarctica, Asia, Europe, North America, Oceania, South America) — where each rule uses an ogc:PropertyIsEqualTo filter on the 'continent' attribute and a PolygonSymbolizer with a distinct fill color. (5) Set 'continent_colors' as the default style for the 'regional_atlas:countries' layer.
